# Preprocessing and encoding log (generated by scripts/evaluate.py)

## MIMIC-IV-ED Demo v2.2

| # | Step | Rows before | Rows after | Detail |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | load triage.csv | 222 | 222 | one row per ED stay |
| 2 | join edstays.csv on stay_id (gender, race, arrival) | 222 | 222 |  |
| 3 | drop stays without ESI acuity (unlabelled) | 222 | 207 | 15 removed |
| 4 | map ESI acuity -> 3-class label (1-2 High, 3 Medium, 4-5 Low) | 207 | 207 | High: 115, Medium: 90, Low: 2 |
| 5 | drop empty chief complaints | 207 | 207 |  |
| 6 | vital signs: numeric coercion, plausibility ranges, unit fix | 207 | 207 | temperature: 11 missing, 0 implausible -> NaN, 1 Celsius values converted to F; heart_rate: 9 missing, 0 implausible -> NaN; resp_rate: 8 missing, 0 implausible -> NaN; o2sat: 9 missing, 0 implausible -> NaN; sbp: 8 missing, 0 implausible -> NaN; dbp: 8 missing, 1 implausible -> NaN |
| 7 | pain: keep numeric 0-10, others (e.g. 'unable', 'UA', '13') -> NaN | 207 | 207 | 19 non-numeric/out-of-range -> NaN |
| 8 | final MIMIC evaluation set | 207 | 207 | 56 patients; High: 115, Medium: 90, Low: 2 |

## KTAS (Moon et al., 2019)

| # | Step | Rows before | Rows after | Detail |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | load ktas_raw.csv (from PLoS S1 XLSX) | 1267 | 1267 | 24 columns |
| 2 | chief complaint: strip, Unicode->ASCII, translate Korean (fixed dictionary), expand F/C and C/S | 1267 | 1267 | kept: 1240, translated: 21, normalised: 6 |
| 3 | drop unreadable complaints | 1267 | 1267 | 0 removed |
| 4 | vital signs: unmeasurable marker -> NaN, comma decimal -> dot, numeric coercion | 1267 | 1267 | SBP: 25 '측불' (unmeasurable), 0 comma decimals, 25 missing after coercion; DBP: 29 '측불' (unmeasurable), 0 comma decimals, 29 missing after coercion; HR: 20 '측불' (unmeasurable), 0 comma decimals, 20 missing after coercion; RR: 22 '측불' (unmeasurable), 0 comma decimals, 22 missing after coercion; BT: 18 '측불' (unmeasurable), 0 comma decimals, 18 missing after coercion; Saturation: 9 '측불' (unmeasurable), 0 comma decimals, 697 missing after coercion |
| 5 | body temperature deg C -> deg F (MIMIC unit) | 1267 | 1267 | F = C x 9/5 + 32 |
| 6 | plausibility ranges (implausible -> NaN) | 1267 | 1267 | temperature: 0; heart_rate: 0; resp_rate: 0; o2sat: 1; sbp: 0; dbp: 0 |
| 7 | pain: Pain flag 0 (no pain) -> NRS 0; NRS kept 0-10 | 1267 | 1267 | 3 missing after rule |
| 8 | encode Sex (1 F / 2 M), Mental (AVPU), Arrival mode and Injury as text | 1267 | 1267 | one-hot encoded later for the ML baselines |
| 9 | labels: KTAS_expert -> 3-class ground truth; KTAS_RN -> nurse baseline (H) | 1267 | 1267 | truth Low: 534, Medium: 487, High: 246; nurse Low: 588, Medium: 447, High: 232 |
| 10 | final KTAS evaluation set | 1267 | 1267 | excluded as inputs: KTAS_RN, KTAS_expert, Error_group, mistriage, Diagnosis in ED, Disposition, Length of stay_min, KTAS duration_min |

## Encoding for the ML baselines (S2a/S2b)

| Feature group | Columns | Transformation |
|---|---|---|
| Text | chief complaint | shared clinical normaliser (`retrieval_service._normalise`: abbreviations, lay synonyms, stop-words, plural stripping) -> TF-IDF (sklearn TfidfVectorizer) |
| Numeric | temperature (F), heart_rate, resp_rate, o2sat, sbp, dbp, pain (+ age for KTAS) | median imputation + missing-indicator columns -> StandardScaler |
| Categorical | gender (+ consciousness, arrival_mode, injury for KTAS) | OneHotEncoder(handle_unknown='ignore') |
| Label | ESI / KTAS_expert | 1-2 High, 3 Medium, 4-5 Low |

## Encoding for the retrieval agent (S1/S4) and the LLM (S3/S4)

| Input | Encoding |
|---|---|
| Chief complaint | normalised tokens -> TF-IDF cosine vs complaint, diagnosis and medication fields of each KB case |
| Vitals | Gaussian kernel on clinically scaled differences (scales: temp 2 F, HR 25, RR 6, SpO2 4, SBP 25, DBP 15) |
| LLM user message | 'Patient statement' + 'Structured intake data' lines (age, sex, vitals, pain, AVPU, arrival, injury) |
| NEWS2 | RR, SpO2 (scale 1), SBP, HR, temperature (F->C), consciousness when known; room air assumed |
